items.source: Create a new StandardServletEnvironment instance with a specific MutablePropertySources instance.
items.translation: 创建一个新的带有特定MutablePropertySources实例的StandardServletEnvironment实例。

items.source: Replace any stub property source instances acting as placeholders with real servlet context/config property sources using the given parameters.
items.translation: 将任何作为占位符的stub property source实例替换为使用给定参数的真实 servlet 上下文/配置属性源。

items.source: Contributes ServletConfig, ServletContext, and JNDI-based PropertySource instances. See customizePropertySources(MutablePropertySources) method documentation for details.
items.translation: 提供 `ServletConfig`、`ServletContext` 以及基于 JNDI 的PropertySource实例。有关详细信息，请参阅customizePropertySources(MutablePropertySources)方法文档。

items.source: The Servlet-related property sources are added as stubs at this stage, and will be fully initialized once the actual ServletContext object becomes available.
items.translation: `Servlet` 相关的属性源在此阶段被添加为 `stubs`，一旦实际的 `ServletContext` 对象可用，它们将被完全初始化。

items.source: Properties present in "servletConfigInitParams" will take precedence over those in "servletContextInitParams", and properties found in either of the above take precedence over those found in "jndiProperties".
items.translation: `"servletConfigInitParams"` 中存在的属性将优先于 `"servletContextInitParams"` 中的属性，而在上述任一位置找到的属性均优先于 `"jndiProperties"` 中找到的属性。

items.source: Addition of "jndiProperties" can be disabled with JndiLocatorDelegate.IGNORE_JNDI_PROPERTY_NAME.
items.translation: 添加 `"jndiProperties"` 的功能可以通过设置`JndiLocatorDelegate.IGNORE_JNDI_PROPERTY_NAME`来禁用。

items.source: Properties in any of the above will take precedence over system properties and environment variables contributed by the StandardEnvironment superclass.
items.translation: 上述任何属性都将优先于由 `StandardEnvironment` 超类提供的系统属性和环境变量。

items.source: Customize the set of property sources with those contributed by superclasses as well as those appropriate for standard servlet-based environments: "servletConfigInitParams" "servletContextInitParams" "jndiProperties"
items.translation: 自定义属性源集合，包括由父类贡献的属性源以及适用于标准 Servlet 环境的属性源： "servletConfigInitParams" "servletContextInitParams" "jndiProperties"
